name: no-effect
description: Identifies CSS declarations that have no effect in the rendered page, powered by a real Chromium engine via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Analyzes stylesheets, embedded <style> blocks, and inline style="" attributes, dimming inactive properties with DevTools-inspired tooltips right in your editor

untrustedWorkspaces.description: NoEffect must ACTIVATE in untrusted workspaces to show its trust notification ('NoEffect needs a trusted workspace' with Trust Workspace / Diagnose Setup actions). Analysis itself stays safely blocked: the readiness gate reports the workspace-blocked state, the browser is never launched, and Diagnose Setup explains why.

noEffect.enabled.description: Enable or disable the NoEffect extension.

noEffect.analyzeOnSave.description: Run analysis automatically when a CSS or HTML file is saved.

noEffect.analyzeOnType.markdownDescription:
Run analysis automatically after a pause in typing (debounced by `noEffect.debounceMs`).

> **Experimental** — live typing analysis is not fully supported: the extension reads **saved files from disk**, so unsaved (dirty) files are skipped with a `FILE_UNSAVED` notice until you save. Enable only if you accept the extra Chromium churn.

noEffect.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before running analysis after typing stops.

enumDescriptions: Show both the inline warning icon and dim the property
Show only the inline warning icon
noEffect.highlightStyle.description: Choose which visual indicators to display for inactive properties.

noEffect.chromiumPath.description: Custom path to a Chromium-based browser executable. Leave empty to auto-detect common installs. A machine-level setting: workspace values are ignored in untrusted workspaces.

noEffect.ignoredFiles.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from analysis (e.g. 'vendor/**', 'node_modules/**'). Built-in defaults: node_modules, bower_components, vendor, dist, build, coverage, out, VCS and IDE directories, and minified/bundle CSS.

noEffect.maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum file size in kilobytes for a single CSS/HTML file to be analyzed. Larger files are skipped.

noEffect.companionSearchDepth.description: Maximum directory depth of the companion-document search: when a CSS file has no linking HTML in its own directory, NoEffect looks for one in the surrounding project tree (depth 1 = one level up and down).

noEffect.companionMaxCandidates.description: Maximum number of scan operations (directories visited + candidate HTML documents) per companion-document search. The search stops once the bound is reached; very large projects may need a higher bound.

noEffect.maxCompanions.description: Maximum number of linking HTML documents analyzed for a CSS file (Top-K evidence budget). More companions means more real ground truth: a declaration stays active when it is effective in ANY analyzed document. This is an evidence budget, not a correctness guarantee — raising it analyzes more pages, lowering it analyzes fewer.

scripts.test:smoke:min: npm run compile && npm run build && node out/test/smoke/runSmoke.js 1.85.0
scripts.test:smoke:all: npm run compile && npm run build && node out/test/smoke/runSmoke.js 1.85.0 && node out/test/smoke/runSmoke.js stable
